ways.label: Mahaukura Track from Grey Road car park to Pirongia summit viewing tower
evidence: From Grey Road car park, follow the track to Wharauroa Lookout then on for another 30 min to Mahaukura.
From Mahaukura, the track descends steeply before climbing again towards Pirongia summit viewing tower.

ways.label: Tirohanga to Mahaukura round trip

via.name: Mahaukura Track
via.quote: Return via Mahaukura Track to Grey Road

evidence: Cross from Grey Road car park to Ruapane via the Mangakara Nature Walk and Link Track then follow the Tirohanga Track to the summit viewing tower.
Return via Mahaukura Track to Grey Road.

access_points.name: O'Shea Road
access_points.quote: This track can also be accessed off O’Shea Road via the Wharauroa Track.

doubts: The end, 'Pirongia summit viewing tower', is left without a ref: the names list both a peak 'Pirongia' (T10) and 'Pirongia Mountain' (T12) and the text does not say which is the summit. Wharauroa Lookout and Mahaukura Lookout are given the peaks of the same names (T18, T9) on the assumption the lookouts are those peaks. Grey Road car park is given as F3, the only Grey Road road end (where Mangakara Nature Walk meets Grey Road); the text does not name the track at the car park. Pāhautea Hut is mentioned only as where people overnight on the round trip; the text does not say either way passes it.
